name: Aster Medcity
tagline: JCI‑ and NABH‑accredited quaternary care hospital in Kochi with dedicated international‑patient services
summary: Aster Medcity is an 800‑bed quaternary care hospital on a 40‑acre waterfront campus in Cheranalloor, Kochi. It holds JCI and NABH accreditations and runs a dedicated international‑patients desk for…
description: Aster Medcity is a large quaternary‑care multispecialty hospital in Cheranalloor (Kochi) with an 800‑bed capacity and multiple centres of excellence including cardiac sciences, neurosciences, oncology, transplant and robotic surgery.

The hospital holds Joint Commission International (JCI) accreditation and NABH accreditation (certificate scope and validity listed by NABH). Aster is part of the Aster DM Healthcare group and positions itself as a medical‑tourism destination serving domestic and international patients.

Visitors find high‑precision diagnostics and therapeutics (including da Vinci robotic surgery programs and multi‑organ transplant services), a dedicated international‑patient lounge/OP area, language support and tie‑ups for local accommodation and airport transfers. Confirm appointment, visa and logistics details with the international patients desk before travel.
highlights: JCI‑accredited (Joint Commission International) and NABH‑accredited facility
Centres of excellence: cardiac, neurosciences, oncology, transplant, robotic surgery
Dedicated international‑patient services and exclusive OP/international lounge
Recent expansion: new tower adding beds and specialised units (cardiac, aesthetics)
Robotic surgery and high‑precision transplant programmes

sections.heading: Background
body: Aster Medcity opened as a quaternary‑care referral hospital in Cheranalloor, Kochi, on a 40‑acre waterfront campus. It operates multiple centres of excellence and advanced programmes such as robotic surgery and multi‑organ transplantation.

The hospital seeks international accreditation and quality benchmarks; it holds the JCI Gold Seal and NABH certification covering extensive clinical, diagnostic and support services (certificate details available from NABH).

sections.heading: What to see and do
body: A visit to Aster Medcity for care focuses on consultations, diagnostics and planned procedures. International patients use the dedicated international‑patient desk and lounge for streamlined appointments, language support, medical visa letters and coordination of outpatient and inpatient services.

Clinically notable services include the Aster Minimal Access Robotic Surgery (MARS) programme, organ‑transplant teams (liver, kidney, heart and more), specialised cardiac and neuro programmes, and multi‑disciplinary oncology care.

sections.heading: Plan your visit
body: Contact the international‑patient desk before you travel to arrange appointments, visa invitation/medical visa documentation, airport pick‑up and accommodation. Many services require referral letters, recent investigations and pre‑authorisation from insurers—confirm requirements in advance.

For non‑medical visitors or family, confirm visiting hours and accommodation options with the hospital; transport from Cochin International Airport typically takes under an hour by road depending on traffic. Always confirm logistics and clinician availability before booking travel.

latest.text: Aster Medcity inaugurates a fourth tower, adding around 100 beds and new specialised units including the renovated cardiac centre and expanded aesthetics/consultation facilities.

A dedicated OP area / exclusive outpatient lounge for international patients is inaugurated, staffed with support personnel, language translators and a screening physician to streamline international consultations.
NABH certification record shows Aster Medcity’s NABH accreditation renewed (certificate valid from 2025-03-31 through 2029-03-30) with a defined scope of clinical and diagnostic services.

visitorInfo.bestTime: Year‑round — hospital services and international‑patient support operate all year (confirm appointments and clinician availability before travel).
visitorInfo.howToReach: Cochin International Airport (CIAL) is the nearest airport (~25 km by road). The hospital is on Kuttisahib Road, Cheranalloor (near Kothad Bridge); Edappally railway station is the closest major rail node (approx. 7 km). Use prearranged airport transfer or taxi; confirm pickup with the international patients desk.
etiquette: Contact the international‑patient desk before booking travel to arrange appointments, visa letters and airport pickup.
Bring referral letters, recent investigation reports and a list of current medicines; ask the hospital about insurer pre‑authorisation if you seek cashless treatment.
Ask for language support / translator ahead of arrival if required; GCC representatives or direct contacts may be available for patients from Middle East countries.
Confirm accommodation and local transport options with the hospital’s international‑patient team — they list partner hotels and guest houses.
